measures.name: Number of Kaimahi SPLY
measures.expression:
VAR OneYearAgo = EDATE(TODAY(), -12)
VAR SPLYKaimahi = CALCULATE(
    [Unique Kaimahi],
    'Fact Kaimahi'[Company Start Date] <= OneYearAgo,
    'Fact Kaimahi'[Company End Date] >= OneYearAgo 
        || ISBLANK('Fact Kaimahi'[Company End Date])
)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(SPLYKaimahi), 0, SPLYKaimahi)

measures.name: Active Kaimahi at Period End
measures.expression:
VAR LatestSnapshot = MAX('Fact Kaimahi'[Snapshot Date])
RETURN
CALCULATE(
    [Unique Kaimahi],
    'Fact Kaimahi'[Snapshot Date] = LatestSnapshot,
    'Fact Kaimahi'[Employment Status At Snapshot] = "Active"
)
